function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Research the target “Conti ransomware leaks and public attribution record” comprehensively. Use only evidence that you return with stable source IDs, and include those source IDs for every material proposition. Prioritize original Conti leak materials (such as chat logs, blog or infrastructure disclosures, and contemporaneous technical analyses), official law-enforcement, court, indictment, sanctions, and government cybersecurity records, then reputable media or research organizations where primary evidence is unavailable. Determine how public sources characterize Conti as a ransomware-as-a-service operation; what leaks support about its organization, roles, management, recruitment, negotiations, finances, operations, infrastructure, affiliates, and internal structure; and how official or other public records connect specific aliases, identities, defendants, charges, or persons of interest to Conti activity. For every person or alias, report only relationships directly stated by a source, not inferred from writing style, wallet, malware, or role similarities. Carefully distinguish verified technical or documentary facts, allegations in charging documents, official assessments, media characterizations, and unresolved uncertainty. Identify contradictions and competing accounts, including disagreement over names, roles, dates, organizational structure, or attribution. Do not invent source IDs, names, relationships, or facts. Return a structured research dossier with: (1) source ID, title, publisher/issuer, date, source type, and URL or locator where available; (2) evidence excerpts or precise summaries; (3) normalized entities and explicitly stated relationships; (4) confidence/status labels such as verified fact, allegation, official assessment, media characterization, or uncertain; and (5) a coverage/gaps section stating where evidence is insufficient. The final answer will be required to cite only your source IDs, so make the IDs unambiguous and attach them to each claim."}
function.name: ConductResearch
